metadata.title: Identity (Non-Human)

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for Identity and Access Management governing non-human (service and workload) identities.

props.name: technology-platform
props.remarks: Non-human identity, workload identity, and service credential services.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Workload and service identity with short-lived credentials and identity-bound execution contexts.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Digital Identity representing a non-human actor.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Service credentials, workload identity tokens, and associated metadata.

props.name: threat-technique
props.remarks: Unsecured credentials, including hard-coded or leaked service secrets.

props.name: threat-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid non-human or service accounts.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Managed lifecycle, binding, and rotation of service and workload identities.

metadata.remarks:
Identity (Non-Human) defines the capability to issue, manage, bind, rotate, and revoke identities for services, workloads, and automated processes. Non-human identities require different lifecycle, trust, and protection models than human identities and must not rely on shared or static secrets.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for roles and responsibilities, SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance activities related to non-Human identity usage. Controls are intentionally scoped to specific non-Human identity sub-capabilities.

components.title: Service Identities
components.description: Definition and management of identities assigned to long-lived services and applications.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Establish and manage identities for non-human service accounts.
Manage service accounts separately from human user accounts.

components.title: Workload Identities
components.description: Ephemeral identities issued to workloads, jobs, and execution environments.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Use strong, cryptographic mechanisms for workload identity authentication.
Apply least privilege to workload identities based on function.

components.title: Identity Binding
components.description: Binding of identity to a specific service instance, workload, or execution context.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Protect authenticators and bind them to specific non-human entities.
Ensure identity assertions are cryptographically bound to execution context.

components.title: Rotation and Revocation
components.description: Automated rotation, expiration, and revocation of non-human identity credentials.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Rotate and revoke non-human authenticators according to defined policy.
Disable or remove non-human identities that are no longer required.
